Doing One Thing at a Time

For anyone whose attention is pulled in five directions at once. Each day is one small way to give a single task, conversation or moment your full attention, from washing a dish to reading a page, and let the rest wait.

Focus · Mindfulness · Stress · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Hold a warm mug in both hands this morning and drink it slowly, with nothing else in front of you.
  • Day 2Settle into your seat before work or study today, take one easy breath, and begin with a single small task.
  • Day 3Turn your phone face down on the table the next time someone sits down to talk with you.
  • Day 4Step outside your door for two minutes and feel the air on your face, doing nothing else.
  • Day 5Choose the one thing that matters most today and write it on a small card you can see.
  • Day 6Wash the dishes tonight with the radio and screens off, feeling the warm water and one plate at a time.
  • Day 7Close every browser tab but one for the next fifteen minutes, and work only in that window.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30When you notice you have drifted from a task, say "back to this" softly and return.
  • Day 60Describe what done looks like for one task before you start it, so you know when to stop.
  • Day 120Return to your one important thing after lunch, even if the morning went sideways.
  • Day 240Take one thing off your plate this spring, like a regular commitment you no longer enjoy.
  • Day 365Write one sentence tonight about what doing one thing at a time has given you, and keep it where you will see it.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
